summary: Keep the pickup operation id on unknown schedule outcomes, require a confirmation before cancellation reconcile updates rows, compare pickup close times as clock values, and finish the shipment-column migration when another open already added the column.
reason: An outcome_unknown pickup can only be reconciled by operation id, an empty confirmation matches every unconfirmed attempt, FedEx accepts both HH:MM and HH:MM:SS, and two first opens after upgrade can both try the same ALTER TABLE.
